lines.zh: 洞顶倒挂的石锥，是我家。
lines.en: The stone fangs overhead are my home.

lines.zh: 爪子叩着湿石，嗒嗒作响。
lines.en: My claws tap the wet stone, click click.

lines.zh: 水滴在我背上，凉得像刀。
lines.en: A drop lands on my back, cold as a blade.
We move as a pack along the stone wall.

lines.zh: 我把爪子磨在滴水石上。
lines.en: I hone my claws on the dripping stone.
The only echo here is water.

lines.zh: 我跳过那道裂缝，很轻松。
lines.en: I leap that crevice without effort.
There's torch smoke up ahead, human smell.
My tail brushes a stalactite as I pass.

lines.zh: 湿地上留不下我的脚印。
lines.en: The wet floor keeps none of my prints.
Height is safety; the floor is too bright.

lines.zh: 我边走边数滴水的节奏。
lines.en: I walk in time with the dripping.

lines.zh: 石缝里有我的同伴气味。
lines.en: A crack smells of my packmates.
Don't step on that loose slab.

lines.zh: 一滴、两滴，我在等第三滴。
lines.en: One drop, two, I wait for the third.
I doze while hanging from a spike.
My claws are dull; time to sharpen them.

lines.zh: 洞穴安静得能听见自己。
lines.en: The cave is quiet enough to hear myself.
I lick my wrist to keep it wet.
Water seeps from the crack overhead.
I turn my ears toward the distance.

lines.zh: 同伴在另一面石壁上叫。
lines.en: A packmate calls from the far wall.

lines.zh: 这里的石头一直在滴水。
lines.en: These stones never stop dripping.

lines.zh: 我把自己团成灰白的一坨。
lines.en: I fold myself into a gray-white lump.

lines.zh: 洞顶倒挂着的我在看你。
lines.en: I watch you hanging from the cave roof.

lines.zh: 火把举高一点，我看不清。
lines.en: Raise the torch; I can't see you.
Your boot looks good for clawing.
I tilt my head to measure the distance.
How many more stand behind you?
Don't blink; I move first.
Under the stalactites, I drip and drool.
You're too loud against the dripping.
I've noted the color of your torch.
My shadow climbs the stone wall.
Hiss. You broke my swing.
I slide down off the stone wall.
My claws go slack and lose the stone.

lines.zh: 这伤口在滴水声里发烫。
lines.en: The wound burns in time with the dripping.
I retreat toward the dark, not toward you.

lines.zh: 同伴叫了一声，是在问我。
lines.en: A packmate calls once, asking if I'm alive.

lines.zh: 刀锋滑过肩头，削掉一撮毛。
lines.en: Your blade slides off my shoulder, shaving fur.
I lick my split claw.
The pain only makes me want to claw.
I press to the wall, breathing loud.
That stuff? I don't eat it.
I only want something warm.

lines.zh: 你把食物举得再高也没用。
lines.en: Hold the food higher; it changes nothing.

lines.zh: 我的牙是为了爪子之后的。
lines.en: My teeth come after my claws.
Sweetness just makes me sneeze.
The cave bugs taste better than that.
Your hand carries another smell too.

lines.zh: 洞顶滴下的水，比食物还甜。
lines.en: The water dripping from above tastes sweeter than food.
Put it away; don't waste it.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，不是食物。
lines.en: I stare at your hand, not the food.
Who bumped me? I was hanging there.

lines.zh: 我用肩膀顶回去，爪子还滴着水。
lines.en: I shove back with my shoulder, claws still dripping.
You broke our pack's formation.
My wet fur smeared onto your trousers.
The hit slid me down the wall.
My claws scrape out a line of sparks.
Don't crowd; only one fits here.
I'm braced now; try that again.

lines.zh: 滴水石洞里，我跳到你身上。
lines.en: I leap at you from a dripstone cave.
Stone grit falls into my ear.
My packmates below are chittering at me.
We huddle so the cold stays out.
We scream together at the stone wall.
Her claws are shorter than mine.

lines.zh: 我把最干的石缝让给她。
lines.en: I give her the driest crack.

lines.zh: 我们的叫声在洞里叠起来。
lines.en: Our calls fold over each other in the cave.
I groom the wet fur on her back.

lines.zh: 滴水声盖不过她的呼吸。
lines.en: The dripping can't drown out her breathing.
Beneath the stone spikes is our nest.
She nips my ear, very gently.
We take turns keeping watch.
However loud the cave, I hear her.
This one glints; I'm taking it.
I pinch a bone shard in my claws.
Everything shiny goes into the nest.
You dropped it; now it's mine.
I climb the wall with it in my teeth.
This one's too small to be quick.
Nothing soft is ever found in caves.
I stuff it into a stone crack.
This dripstone goes back to my nest.
Gather more to line the nest in winter.
The wall moved; I smelled it.
I give my packmates a low call.

lines.zh: 跳得到的高度，就是我的。
lines.en: Anywhere I can leap is mine.

lines.zh: 你踩进石笋坑的那一声。
lines.en: That clink when you stepped into the dripstone pit.
I've counted your steps; that's enough.
First my claws grip the stone.
Coming from above spends the least effort.
Three of us. That is enough.
I flatten myself against the rock face.
Your torch doesn't reach the ceiling.
My drool drips down; don't look up.
I've already worked out this jump.
The pack splits to block both ends.
The stone spike rings; that's the signal.

lines.zh: 洞顶滴水的节奏乱了，有人。
lines.en: The dripping overhead loses its rhythm; someone is here.

lines.zh: 你的火把晃了一下，我看清了。
lines.en: Your torch sways once, and I see you clearly.
I circle you, taking my time.
Under the dripping water I creep half a step closer.

lines.zh: 爪子刮石头的声音，好听吧。
lines.en: Claws on stone. Do you like that sound?
I'm waiting for your sword to rise.
A packmate is already behind you.

lines.zh: 先抓你拿火把的那只手腕。
lines.en: I'll grab the wrist that holds the torch.
The dripping counts the seconds for me.
No rush; the cave is mine.
The tenser you get, the more you open.
We take turns testing your blade.
More shadows gather around your feet.
I bend my knees, ready to leap.
How many steps of retreat remain?
Two more heads poke from the cracks.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶的钟乳石上换位。
lines.en: I switch perches on the stalactites above you.

lines.zh: 你听不见我，滴水声太密。
lines.en: You cannot hear me; the dripping is too dense.

lines.zh: 我离你两跳，先压住呼吸。
lines.en: Two jumps away, I hold my breath.

lines.zh: 你靠着墙走，影子正好斜。
lines.en: You walk by the wall; your shadow tilts just right.

lines.zh: 同伴在你左边的石缝里等。
lines.en: A packmate waits in the crack on your left.

lines.zh: 我把爪尖扣进石面，准备落。
lines.en: I hook my claws into the stone, ready to drop.

lines.zh: 我从洞顶落下去，爪子先到。
lines.en: I drop from the ceiling, claws first.

lines.zh: 这一爪撕开了你的袖口。
lines.en: This swipe tears open your sleeve.
My claws hook into your cloak.
Claws screech across iron.
You raised that shield the wrong way.
I leap up and rake at your face.

lines.zh: 血滴在湿石上，很快没了。
lines.en: Blood drips on wet stone and vanishes.
We swarm together and pin you down.
You cry out, and my claws dig deeper.
I kick off and spring away again.
My teeth are worse than my claws.
I sharpened these claws all night.
You guard your neck; that's smart.
After the strike, I slip into the dark.

lines.zh: 我从侧面扑，爪子先撞上。
lines.en: I lunge from the side, claws hitting first.
This swipe opens your bracer.

lines.zh: 你抬手挡，我的牙咬住指节。
lines.en: You raise an arm; my teeth close on knuckles.

lines.zh: 我落地就弹开，不给你抓。
lines.en: I bounce off on landing so you cannot grab me.
The smell of blood spreads fast in the cave.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖被我踹得一软。
lines.en: My kick buckles your knee.

lines.zh: 我从洞顶的裂缝里挤出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out of a crack in the ceiling.

lines.zh: 湿石的气味，我又回来了。
lines.en: Wet stone smell; I'm back again.
Pack calls sound close by.
First I hang still and read the room.

lines.zh: 滴水正好落在我的鼻尖。
lines.en: A drop lands exactly on my nose.

lines.zh: 这一片石壁还没有主人。
lines.en: This stretch of wall has no master yet.

lines.zh: 我的爪子一落地就抓稳。
lines.en: The instant I land, my claws take hold.

lines.zh: 钟乳石后面先探出爪子。
lines.en: My claws come out from behind the stalactite first.

lines.zh: 一群影子从石缝里爬出。
lines.en: A crowd of shadows crawls from the cracks.
The water sounds thicken in the cave.
I hear a torch being lit again.
This wall is room enough for us.

lines.zh: 火燎到毛，焦味盖过水汽。
lines.en: Fire singes my fur; burnt smell beats the damp.

lines.zh: 石壁没抓住，我一路坠下。
lines.en: The wall slips my grip and I drop.
Water fills my mouth; I can't grip the edge.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀到另一面墙。
lines.en: The blast throws me into the far wall.

lines.zh: 箭钉进肩膀，我挂在半空。
lines.en: An arrow pins my shoulder; I hang midair.

lines.zh: 紫光钻进骨头，爪子不听使唤。
lines.en: Violet light seeps into bone; my claws disobey.
Too starved to grip the stone.

lines.zh: 雷顺着湿石爬到我身上。
lines.en: Lightning crawls up the wet stone to me.
There's no wall beneath, only emptiness.
